appDescription: A driving score app that grades steering and speed habits during a drive and explains each deduction.

function.name: GET_RECENT_DEDUCTIONS
function.description: Returns the driving score deductions of the last few minutes with their reason, place and advice.

minutes.description: How many minutes back to look.

function.name: GET_DRIVE_SUMMARY
function.description: Returns the current drive's driving score and the deductions so far, grouped by reason.

function.name: GET_HABIT_TO_FIX
function.description: Returns the driving habits that cost the most points over the recorded drives and the points each would add.
